title: Keyboard focus and labels: replace removed outlines, announce play/stop, label the Flow canvas
description:
The focusable panels `.flow`, `.beat` and `.harp` set `outline: none` with no replacement focus style (`web/src/style.css:107,261,323`); the only `:focus-visible` rule is for account controls (217). The Flow canvas is mouse-only (click and pointermove, Escape on keydown, `flow/view.ts:61-66`); its root has `tabIndex=0` but no aria-label. The play button's glyph toggles between play and stop (`main.ts:131,157`) but its aria-label stays "Play score". Two colours are hardcoded outside the tokens (`#f59e5b` at `style.css:217`, `#f5b301` at 246).

Done when: every focusable panel has a visible `:focus-visible` style, the play button's label follows its state, the Flow canvas has a label and arrow-key navigation between notes, and the hardcoded colours are tokens.
